parameters.name: NewAccessTokenValidity
parameters.description:
The validity period of the access token.

Valid values: 900 to 10800. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: NewIsMultiTenant
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the application is allowed to be installed by other accounts. Valid values:

- true: Allowed.

- false: Not allowed.

parameters.name: NewPredefinedScopes
parameters.description:
The permission scope of the application.

For more information about the valid values and descriptions of application permission scopes, see [OAuth scopes](~~93693~~). You can also call [ListPredefinedScopes](~~187206~~) to query the permission scopes supported by different application types.

Separate multiple permission scopes with semicolons (;).

The new permission scopes overwrite the existing permission scopes. For example, if the existing permission scope is `/acs/ccc` and you set the new permission scope to `/acs/alidns`, the effective permission scope is `/acs/alidns`. If you want to add `/acs/alidns` to the existing scope, set the new permission scope to `/acs/ccc;/acs/alidns`.

parameters.name: NewRedirectUris
parameters.description:
The callback URLs.

Separate multiple URLs with semicolons (;).

parameters.name: NewRefreshTokenValidity
parameters.description:
The validity period of the refresh token.

Valid values: 7200 to 31536000. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: NewRequiredScopes
parameters.description:
The required permission scopes of the application.

You can set one or more scopes in `RequiredScopes` as required. After a scope is set as required, it is selected by default and cannot be cleared when a user authorizes the application.

If you also specify `NewPredefinedScopes`, the scope list of the application is reset by using `NewPredefinedScopes` first, and then the required scopes are configured by using this parameter.

Separate multiple permission scopes with semicolons (;).

The new required scopes overwrite the existing required scopes.

> If a scope specified in `RequiredScopes` is not included in `PredefinedScopes`, the required scope does not take effect.

parameters.name: NewSecretRequired
parameters.description:
Specifies whether an application secret is required. Valid values:

- true
- false

> - For WebApp and ServerApp applications, this value is forcibly set to true and cannot be modified.
- For NativeApp applications, this value can be set to true or false. If not specified, the default value is false. Because such applications often run in untrusted environments and cannot effectively protect application secrets, do not set this value to true unless you have a specific need.
